_README: Every external fact the planner depends on. The freshness checker (check-freshness.mjs) fetches each `url` and flags drift: a dead/moved link (bad HTTP status), or — when `watch` text is given — content that no longer contains the expected marker (a sign the page was restructured). It FLAGS for human review; it never edits data. To add a dependency, add an entry here. `kind` is informational. `note` tells a human what to verify if this item is flagged.

dependencies.label: Live course rotation Google Sheet (drives course availability)
dependencies.note: If content changed, that's expected (the chair edits it). The checker reports WHETHER it changed since last run so you know the live data moved. If it 404s, the Publish-to-web link broke — re-publish and update live-source.js PUBLISHED_URL.

dependencies.label: URI Kuali catalog API (current catalog id)
dependencies.note: The live catalog text comes from this API (catalog.js). A new catalog id each year is normal. If it 404s or stops returning JSON, the API moved — catalog.js needs updating.

dependencies.label: URI catalog — Bachelor of Music program page
dependencies.note: Program id BM_PID in catalog.js. If the BM program id changed, update catalog.js. (Hash-routed SPA; the checker only verifies the catalog host responds.)

dependencies.label: URI catalog — B.A. Music program page
dependencies.note: Program id BA_PID in catalog.js. If the BA program id changed, update catalog.js.

dependencies.label: URI standard class meeting-time blocks (admin conflict checker)
dependencies.note: The admin Course Rotation Builder's STANDARD_BLOCKS come from this page. If the page content changed, re-read it and update STANDARD_BLOCKS in site/admin/admin.js.

dependencies.label: Apply for Graduation page (button + forms repo)
dependencies.note: LINKS.graduation in data.js. If moved, update the url (it also has a search fallback).

dependencies.label: A&S Curriculum Modification form (PDF)
dependencies.note: RESOLUTIONS.modification + forms repo in data.js. PDFs move often — if flagged, find the current PDF and update the url.

dependencies.label: How transfer credit works at URI
University Manual Ch. 8 (double-major GPA/residency/degree rules)
dependencies.note: DOUBLE_MAJOR rules cite this. If flagged, re-read and re-verify the double-major rule text in data.js.

dependencies.label: URI undergraduate majors list (external double-major options)
dependencies.note: EXTERNAL_PROGRAMS in data.js is derived from this page. If it changed, new/renamed/removed majors may need updating in the list.
